Name: Corner Gate
Description: A gate of Jerusalem's wall, broken down by Jehoash from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits, and repaired under Uzziah, and named as the limit of the restored city in Zechariah's vision.
BiblicalSignificance: The Corner Gate is a wall's corner turned to prophecy: breached in war, repaired by a king, and named as the edge of the city to come.
